Mýrarkvísl: Trout and Salmon Fishing in Iceland

Choose trout or salmon for an outing on the Mýrarkvísl. Spend an Icelandic fishing day focused on this small river and your next cast.

About this water

The fishery source record for Mýrarkvísl, Iceland, identifies brown trout (Salmo trutta) and Atlantic salmon.

At Mýrarkvísl, distinguish a trout-focused outing from an Atlantic-salmon booking before choosing a rod. Ask the provider to identify the allocated reach and describe the casting space and expected presentation. Brown trout belongs to the Salmo trutta entry in the catalog; the label does not settle the trip format. Confirm supplied equipment and daily transport. A generic Iceland checklist cannot replace the access and target agreement for this river.

Ask about bank vegetation, casting space and the expected flies so that the rod you pack fits the actual reach rather than a generic Iceland packing list.
